disease_label_per_paper: Hematogenous Candida endophthalmitis in candidemia after intravenous hyperalimentation through a femoral line
presentation_summary: A 34-year-old woman developed fever, chills, ocular pain, and blurred vision after corrosive esophagitis requiring femoral line placement and intravenous hyperalimentation.
At admission she was acutely ill with temperature 38.5 C, hemoglobin 9.3 g/dL, WBC 13.6 x10^9/L, neutrophils 84.7%, and platelets 216 x10^9/L.
Ophthalmologic exam showed decreased visual acuity, hazy vitreous with inflammatory cells, and white granulomatous mounds on both maculae.
Blood and femoral catheter tip fungal cultures were positive for Candida albicans.
